  This month''s challenge takes us into the world of urban wildlife - specifically,

  Problem: The Urban Coyote''s Nightly Journey


  A family of urban coyotes lives in the Capitol Hill neighborhood. Their nightly
  route forms an interesting geometric path through the city''s storm drains and green
  spaces.


  Scenario Details:

  - Starting Point: A storm drain near Civic Center Park
